title: nb.plaintext_coefficients, version 1
description: One line of <dir>/vectors.jsonl, the directory NB_PLAINTEXT_VECTORS names: one coefficient-domain plaintext mul_coeffs encoded, appended when it is encoded. Its values, the polynomial's ring_dim real coefficients, are in <dir>/pv_<n>.f64. See dsl_fhe/docs/RUN_METADATA.md.

version.description: The schema's version. A consumer rejects a version it does not know.

tag.description: pv:<n>: the n-th plaintext of the process that a ciphertext-vector operation or mul_coeffs encoded, from 0, in the order they are encoded (one numbering for both schemas). Its values are in pv_<n>.f64 next to this file.

length.description: The number of values, the ring dimension: pv_<n>.f64 holds length float64 coefficients, 8 * length bytes.

level.description: The level the plaintext is encoded at.

slots.description: The slot count it is encoded with: length / 2, every slot.

noise_scale_deg.description: The noise scale degree it is encoded with: always 1.
